# Check if there is any row where competition contains "olympic games" and position indicates a medal (1st, 2nd, or 3rd)
# Assuming medal positions are exactly "1st", "2nd", or "3rd" (or contain these substrings)
# We'll filter for rows with competition containing "olympic games" and position being one of the medal positions
olympic_rows = df[df['competition'].str.contains('olympic games', case=False, na=False)]
# Check if any of these rows have position that is a medal position
medal_positions = ['1st', '2nd', '3rd']
has_medal = olympic_rows['position'].isin(medal_positions).any()
# Add explicit check operation
answer = bool(has_medal)
